data.headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Equal-Weight on Phillips 66, Raises Price Target to $147
data.summary: Morgan Stanley  analyst Erin Wright    maintains Phillips 66 (NYSE:PSX) with a Equal-Weight and raises the price target from $140 to $147.
